before.title: AdBlue/DEF System Faults and Injector Crystallization
before.description: The diesel Velar models are prone to AdBlue (DEF) system faults caused by the AdBlue injector crystallizing. Crystallized AdBlue blocks the injector and prevents proper urea injection into the exhaust, triggering a countdown to engine restart lockout. The AdBlue heater and level sensor also fail, giving false empty readings even with a full tank.
before.solution: Replace the AdBlue injector and clean the injector mounting area of crystallization. Replace the AdBlue heater element if faulty. Use only ISO 22241-compliant AdBlue fluid. If the restart countdown has begun, a dealer must reset it with diagnostic equipment before the vehicle locks out.
symptoms: Engine restart in X miles countdown message
AdBlue level reads empty when full
Reduced engine power in limp mode
Check engine light with NOx sensor codes

citations.title: JLR TSB LTB00561 — AdBlue system crystallization diagnosis and repair

communityRecommendations.content: Do NOT ignore the AdBlue countdown. Once it reaches zero, the engine will not restart until a dealer resets it. This can happen far from home.

proposal.title: AdBlue/DEF System Faults and Injector Crystallization
proposal.description: JLR records for 2018-2020 diesel Velar vehicles document DEF dosing or quality warnings, restart countdowns and DTCs including P203B-31, P208A-13 and P208C-11. One primary record directs technicians to check DEF quality and inspect the injector for crusting or leaks, but treats the condition as under investigation. The evidence does not establish injector, heater and level-sensor failure across 2018-2024.
proposal.solution: Record the exact warning, remaining restart distance, DTCs, DEF level and fluid quality, then follow the current VIN-specific JLR primary and secondary diagnostic path. Do not replace the injector, heater, level sensor or tank or clear a countdown from this page; crusting is a diagnostic finding, not a universal cause, and no verified retail part is linked.

before.title: Deployable Door Handle Mechanism Failure
before.description: The Velar features flush-mounted deployable door handles that extend outward when the vehicle is unlocked. The electric motors and gear mechanisms inside the handles fail, leaving the handle stuck flush or stuck in the extended position. Cold weather and water ingress accelerate the failure. A stuck handle can trap occupants inside or prevent entry.
before.solution: Replace the door handle actuator motor and mechanism. JLR has revised the design on newer production vehicles. Apply silicone spray to the handle mechanisms seasonally to prevent water intrusion. In an emergency, the door can be opened from the inside using the manual release.
symptoms: Door handle does not deploy when vehicle is unlocked
Door handle deploys but does not retract
Grinding noise from door handle area
Door handle warning message on dashboard

citations.title: NHTSA complaints — Velar door handle failures and entry/exit safety concerns

communityRecommendations.content: Spray silicone lubricant into the door handle recesses before winter. Water ingress is the primary cause of handle motor failure.

proposal.title: Deployable Door Handle Mechanism Failure
proposal.description: JLR records document deployable exterior handles that may not fully retract in freezing conditions. The 2018 guidance says this is cosmetic, does not affect the primary handle, lock or security functions, and tells technicians not to replace components when operation returns after warming. Later guidance uses a guided diagnostic flow and limited replacement criteria. That does not support motor/gear failure, occupant entrapment or broad water-ingress claims.
proposal.solution: If a handle does not fully retract in freezing conditions, avoid forcing it, allow all ice to melt and confirm handle and latch operation. Follow the current VIN-specific JLR guided diagnostic flow if the condition remains. Do not replace an actuator, motor or complete handle or apply silicone from this page; no universal retail part is supported.

citations.title: JLR SSM73851 — deployable door-handle operation in freezing conditions
JLR shop-foreman guidance — 2021 deployable door handles
NHTSA Manufacturer Communications — eight Velar deployable-handle records

proposal.contentUpdateSummary: Removed the false occupant-entrapment, motor/gear, water-ingress and blanket replacement claims; retained the documented freezing-condition symptom as a hold.

before.title: Dual Touchscreen Climate and Infotainment Failure
before.description: The Velar's innovative dual-touchscreen interface (Touch Pro Duo) is prone to failures where one or both screens go black, freeze, or become unresponsive. Since all vehicle controls including climate, seat heating, and driving modes are controlled through these screens, a failure leaves the driver without access to essential functions. The lower screen is particularly prone to failure as it controls HVAC.
before.solution: Perform a system reboot by holding both screen power buttons simultaneously. Visit a JLR dealer for software updates. In severe cases, the screen modules need replacement. The lower HVAC screen can be replaced independently of the upper navigation screen.
symptoms: One or both touchscreens go black
Screens freeze and do not respond to touch
Screens restart repeatedly in a loop

citations.title: NHTSA complaints — Range Rover Velar touchscreen failures 2018-2023 (150+ complaints)

communityRecommendations.content: The Velar relies entirely on touchscreens — there are no physical HVAC controls. A screen failure in extreme heat or cold is a safety concern. Keep the software updated.

proposal.title: Dual Touchscreen Climate and Infotainment Failure
proposal.description: JLR communications document Touch Pro Duo and Interactive Control Display Module conditions on specified 2018-2020 Velar vehicles, including blank or flickering displays, involuntary lower-screen inputs, startup failures and software-update problems. They do not establish that both displays fail across every 2018-2024 vehicle, that essential controls are universally lost, or that 2021-2024 Pivi conditions share the same hardware cause.
proposal.solution: Record which display and functions are affected, the installed software level and any IMC, ISC, ICDM or IDMA DTCs, then follow the current VIN-specific JLR software and module workflow. Do not rely on a button-reset sequence or replace either screen or infotainment module from this page; the documented causes differ and no universal retail part is linked.
